summary: Accessibility Widget (Israeli Standard 5568) Testing Complete. All 18 features tested. Found and fixed 1 BUG: localStorage persistence issue (settings were being overwritten on page reload). All features now working correctly.

bugs_found_and_fixed.bug: Settings not persisting after page reload - localStorage was being overwritten with default settings on component mount
bugs_found_and_fixed.root_cause: Race condition between two useEffect hooks - the settings effect saved defaultSettings before the load effect could read saved values
bugs_found_and_fixed.fix_applied: Changed useState initialization to use getInitialSettings() function that reads localStorage synchronously, added isLoaded flag to prevent saving during initial mount

accessibility_toggle_button.details: Visible at bottom-left (24px from left, fixed position), z-index 99999

accessibility_panel_open.details: Opens on button click, all 11 options visible with data-testid

font_increase_הגדלת_גופן.details: Increases font by 15% per click, shows +N badge, root fontSize changes to 130%

high_contrast_ניגודיות_גבוהה.details: Adds a11y-high-contrast class to body, toggles on/off

grayscale_גווני_אפור.details: Adds a11y-grayscale class, filter: grayscale(1) applied

link_highlight_הדגשת_קישורים.details: Adds a11y-link-highlight class, links get underline and outline

readable_font_גופן_קריא.details: Adds a11y-readable-font class, changes font to Arial with increased spacing

stop_animations_עצירת_אנימציות.details: Adds a11y-stop-animations class, removes all CSS animations

big_cursor_סמן_מוגדל.details: Adds a11y-big-cursor class, cursor changes to large pointer

reading_guide_מדריך_קריאה.details: Shows horizontal red line following mouse cursor

highlight_focus_הדגשת_פוקוס.details: Adds a11y-highlight-focus class, focused elements get yellow outline

hide_images_הסתרת_תמונות.details: Adds a11y-hide-images class, images become nearly invisible (opacity 0.05)

localStorage_persistence.details: Settings now persist after page reload

close_panel_x_button.details: Panel closes when X button clicked

close_panel_escape_key.details: Panel closes when Escape key pressed

indicator_dot.details: Yellow/amber dot appears on toggle button when settings are active

keyboard_navigation.details: Tab navigates through options, Enter activates, Escape closes

cookie_consent_coexistence.details: Widget works alongside CookieConsent popup without interference

context_for_next_testing_agent: Accessibility widget (Israeli Standard 5568) fully tested and working. Fixed localStorage persistence bug. All features work on landing page and providers page. Widget coexists with CookieConsent popup.

rca_of_bug_fixed.bug: Settings not persisting after page reload
rca_of_bug_fixed.root_cause: Race condition in useEffect hooks - the second useEffect that saves settings was triggered on initial mount with default values, overwriting localStorage before the first useEffect could load saved values
rca_of_bug_fixed.fix: 1. Changed useState(defaultSettings) to useState(getInitialSettings) - loading saved values synchronously during initialization. 2. Added isLoaded flag to prevent saving during initial mount. 3. Only save to localStorage after component has loaded (isLoaded = true)
